description.value: Best Choice Blueberry Farm is a family-run u-pick and pre-picked blueberry farm on the Tsawwassen/Delta agricultural flats, open seasonally from July through early September. Cyclists can hand-pick fresh blueberries straight from the field or buy pre-packed boxes and organic garlic on-site, with no reservations or entry fee required. The farm is cash-only and is well-regarded by repeat local visitors for its large, sweet berries.
